title: Update visual theme to orange-on-dark with optional red accents

requirements.text: Update the global Tailwind theme tokens to use an orange-forward palette and a near-black (black alternative) background so orange elements have strong contrast, in both light and dark modes.

quotes: use orange colors where ever necessary and the background must be an alternative of black so that orange looks good

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/index.css, the CSS variables for --background/--card/--popover in .dark use a near-black / black-alternative background (not a brown/green-tinted dark), while maintaining readable --foreground contrast.
The primary color token remains clearly orange-forward (buttons/links that use primary read as orange across the app).
No changes are made to any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.text: Replace the current green/forest accent color token with a red accent token and ensure it is used only as an accent (not replacing primary orange), including gradients and decorative elements that reference the accent token.

quotes: also you can use red assents too

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/index.css, --accent and --accent-foreground are updated to a red-accent pair in both :root and .dark.
Brand wordmark gradient styling in frontend/src/index.css uses the updated red accent (via the accent color or updated stop values) so it no longer trends green.
Any existing UI areas using accent token (e.g., Landing page gradient sections using from-primary/... to-accent/...) render with a red-tinted accent rather than green.

requirements.text: Audit top-level page sections (marketing and app) to ensure backgrounds and overlays complement the orange primary on dark/near-black backgrounds, adjusting any page-level utility classes that cause low contrast or clashing hues.

quotes: use orange colors where ever necessary and the background must be an alternative of black so that orange looks good

acceptanceCriteria: Primary CTA buttons and key highlights remain clearly visible and readable on dark/near-black backgrounds across the header, footer, and the landing hero/CTA sections.
Muted/background section fills (e.g., bg-muted/30, gradients) do not wash out orange primary or create muddy contrast in dark mode.
No new user-facing copy is introduced as part of the styling adjustments.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts).
Keep the existing routing and feature pages intact; only adjust styling/theme as needed to achieve the requested palette.
nonGoals: Adding new product features or changing backend APIs/data models.
Implementing third-party theming libraries or redesigning the information architecture.
Creating or replacing logo/hero images as part of this request (unless strictly necessary for contrast issues).

preferencesToAdd: Prefer an orange-forward UI palette with near-black (black alternative) backgrounds and optional red accents.
